# Rules

README.md explains the layout.

## Read when needed

- When you add a check, read `checks/README.md`.
- When you meet a term, read [the glossary](GLOSSARY.md).
- When you add a file to a folder, read that folder's `README.md`.
- when you review, read `README.md`.
- When you add a check or change one,
  read `checks/README.md`.
- When you add a check, read `checks/README.md#adding`.
- When you write C#, read `docs/C#.md`.

Write each pointer like `read [guide][g]`, after its condition.
- When you configure, read [read config.md first](GLOSSARY.md).
- When you edit, see [read missing.md](GLOSSARY.md).
